title: On simples in a cosilting heart and mutation of cosilting pairs
summary: Let $A$ be a finite dimensional algebra. The lattice of torsion pairs in $\rm mod (A)$ is controlled by cosilting pairs, infinitely generated analogues of support $τ^-$-tilting pairs. Then, edges in the Hasse quiver (i.e. minimal inclusions of torsion-free classes) correspond to irreducible mutations of cosilting pairs. An important difference with classical $τ$-tilting theory is that not all indecomposable summands of a cosilting pair are mutable.
